issue: Nine different structural suffixes are used with no defined semantics: condensate (44), body (42), granule (19), compartment (6), complex (5), foci (5), speckle (3), puncta (2), droplet (2). 'foci' and 'puncta' are microscopy descriptions, 'complex' implies stoichiometry, 'droplet' implies liquidity
proposal: Define the suffix vocabulary: use the field-standard name where one exists; otherwise default to '_condensate'. Reserve '_complex' for stoichiometric assemblies (which mostly belong in DISCARD), and replace '_foci'/'_puncta' with '_body' or '_condensate' unless the plural focus form is the literature name (dna_damage_foci is)

issue: Number is inconsistent: 5 terms are plural (dna_damage_foci, hyperosmotic_shock_foci, mutator_foci, proteasome_foci, simr_foci) while 165 are singular
proposal: Singular by default; keep the plural only where the literature name is plural (dna_damage_foci)

issue: 13 terms are named after a single protein (bag2_condensate, ddx1_body, kat6a_condensate, sup35_condensate, tdp43_nuclear_condensate, ...). Protein-named terms conflate 'a condensate containing X' with 'the compartment X defines'
proposal: Acceptable where the protein defines the structure (sam68_nuclear_body, morc3_nuclear_body are established names). For the rest, verify that the source is describing a compartment rather than a protein's phase behaviour; several are candidates for the in-vitro evidence tier

issue: Two canonicals differing only by 'protein' vs 'rnp' receive case variants of the same source label; the distinction is not operationalised anywhere
proposal: Merge into cytoplasmic_rnp_granule with an rna_dependent flag, or define the discriminating criterion explicitly

issue: Names an evidence condition as if it were a compartment; the only term using '_droplet' besides ftsz_droplet
proposal: Remove as a canonical; represent as evidence_type on the annotation

issue: CamelCase placeholder in an otherwise snake_case vocabulary, and not a compartment at all
proposal: Remove; represent missing localisation as NULL

issue: '_droplet' implies in-vitro liquidity; FtsZ condensates are described in vivo
Fungal-specific name receiving 872 mostly-metazoan proteins via the compound label 'Centrosome/Spindle pole body'
proposal: Split the compound label by organism before the term can be trusted; see equivalence_verdicts.csv

issue: Name is used for a term whose curation note describes the Barr body, while the actual sex body (XY body) proteins sit in heterochromatin
proposal: Create xy_body for the meiotic structure; create barr_body if the Xi concept is wanted; correct the sex_body definition

issue: Absorbs euchromatin while heterochromatin is a separate canonical; the name suggests a parent term but behaves as a sibling
proposal: Either make chromatin_compartment an explicit parent with heterochromatin/euchromatin as children, or create euchromatin as a sibling

issue: Two generic signalling terms with no stated boundary; 12 source names route to the first, and it receives 5 conflicting categories
proposal: Define the boundary (cluster = membrane receptor clustering; condensate = cytoplasmic signalosome) or merge
Rename to the literature name or retire
